name: blackraptor-hardware
description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates that block work until it meets the standard. A governed hardware-engineering department plus an adversarial design-review gate, conducted by the hw-program skill (main session), built on the Agent Operating Standard v2. Conductor: the hw-program skill (decision register, interfaces, dispatch, PDR/CDR/MRR gates) — a main-session skill, not a seat. Seats: power-electronics, thermal-mechanical, rf-connectivity, embedded-firmware, reliability-dfr, compliance-cert, manufacturing-dfm, cost-engineer — with hw-design-reviewer as the mandatory second set of eyes before any board spin, tooling commitment, purchase, or external commitment. Product-agnostic: each program supplies its own PROGRAM-CONTEXT.md (template included). Design doctrine baked in: the least expensive device that functions in its conditions for its design life — cost is a requirement with the same standing as performance, over-design is a reviewable defect, datasheets are ground truth, worst-case not typical. Auto-pulls the blackraptor-core pack: product-manager validates requirements against market need at intake and PDR (engineers do not author market requirements), and evidence-auditor + research-integrity gate load-bearing external research claims (pricing, lifecycle, standards applicability). Agents design and analyze — humans make the irreversible calls.
